title: Tapa Works Blog: Aloha Shirt Manufacturing Guides
description: The Tapa Works blog: guides for clothing brands on aloha shirt fabrics, printing, sampling, production and shipping.
heading: Tapa Works Blog
intro: Guides for clothing brands on developing, sampling, making and shipping aloha shirts.

blocks.heading: About Tapa Works
paragraphs: These guides are written by the team that makes your aloha shirts. They follow a shirt the way an order runs: how it is [developed](/product-development/), [sampled](/sampling/), made in [bulk production](/bulk-production/), [checked](/quality-control/) and [shipped](/shipping/), and what each step asks of you as the buyer.

blocks.heading: Send Your Enquiry to Our Factory
paragraphs: Send your enquiry to our factory with your design, picture or idea. We reply within one business day and quote before making your sample once you agree the price.
